manifest.name: GST filing (India)
manifest.description: Builds the monthly GSTR-3B from the host's books in the GSTN format, saves it on the GST portal through a GST Suvidha Provider, and files it with EVC only after a person's yes.

abilities.title: GST returns
abilities.description: GSTR-3B returns this package has prepared, saved or filed, with their figures, how the tax was split, GSP status and portal acknowledgement (ARN).

abilities.title: Prepare the GSTR-3B from the books
abilities.description: Build the month's GSTR-3B (GSTN format) from the ledger: output tax, input tax credit and taxable value are read from the books, never typed in. Give only the month. Internal: nothing leaves the company. The result shows how CGST/SGST/IGST were split and what was assumed.

abilities.title: Save the GSTR-3B on the GST portal
abilities.description: Save the month's prepared GSTR-3B on the GST portal through the GSP (RETSAVE) and check its processing status. Saving is not filing: a saved return can be replaced. Needs a GST portal session; without one the portal sends an OTP to the registered mobile and a person enters it.

abilities.title: Ask the GST portal for an OTP
abilities.description: Ask the GST portal to send an OTP by SMS: 'auth' to the registered mobile (to open a session), 'evc' to the authorised signatory (to sign a filing). A person enters the OTP on the GST portal OTP door; you never see or type it.

abilities.title: File the GSTR-3B
abilities.description: File the month's saved GSTR-3B on the GST portal, signed with EVC. Binding. Give only the month: the proposal is bound to the saved return's figures and hash. The signatory's EVC OTP is entered by a person, never by you.

skills.body:
# Monthly GSTR-3B

The figures come from the books. You name the month; you never type a tax amount, a GSTIN or an OTP.

1. `gst.gstr3b.prepare` with the month (`YYYY-MM`). It reads the ledger (VAT/GST summary, sales, the tax accounts) and builds the GSTR-3B in the GSTN format. Its result shows the figures, how CGST/SGST/IGST were split, and every assumption. If it refuses (a negative figure, tax accounts that name only some heads, no supply assumption configured), report the reason to the person and stop — do not work around it.
2. `gst.gstr3b.save` with the month. It saves the return on the GST portal through the GSP and checks its status. Saving is not filing.
   - If it says there is no GST portal session, an OTP has been sent to the registered mobile: tell the person to enter it on the GST portal OTP door, and finish with `needs_input`.
3. `gst.otp.request` with purpose `evc`, then tell the person the signatory's OTP is on its way and must be entered on the GST portal OTP door before they approve.
4. Propose `gst.gstr3b.file` with the month. The card says: the GSTIN and month, output tax, input tax credit, the net payable (or the credit carried forward), how the tax was split (say plainly when it was an assumption), that filing is binding, and that the person enters the EVC OTP before saying yes.
5. When woken with DONE, report the ARN from the proof and the figures with their source (the ledger's VAT/GST summary for the month). If FAILED, report the reason as given. If UNKNOWN, say the portal has not confirmed it yet and that it will be checked; never propose a second filing for the same month.

What is assumed, always stated: sales = revenue for the month (zero-rated, exempt, non-GST and reverse-charge supplies are not marked in the books and are reported as 0); all input tax is "all other ITC"; interest and late fee are left to the portal; when the books keep one output and one input tax account, the split follows the company's configured assumption (intra-state: CGST = SGST; inter-state: IGST).

migrations.002_gstr3b.sql:
-- 2.0.0: the return is the GSTN GSTR-3B document built from the books, saved on
-- the portal before it is filed. Figures stay in minor units beside the document.
alter table {{schema}}.nep_gst_returns
  add column gstin            text check (gstin is null or gstin ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$'),
  add column ret_period       text check (ret_period is null or ret_period ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])[0-9]{4}$'),
  add column taxable_minor    bigint check (taxable_minor is null or taxable_minor >= 0),
  add column payload          jsonb,
  add column payload_sha256   text,
  add column split_basis      text,
  add column sources          jsonb,
  add column gsp_ref          text,
  add column gsp_status       text;
alter table {{schema}}.nep_gst_returns drop constraint nep_gst_returns_status_check;
alter table {{schema}}.nep_gst_returns add constraint nep_gst_returns_status_check
  check (status in ('draft', 'saved', 'filed', 'superseded'));
-- One filed GSTR-3B per company and month.
create unique index nep_gst_returns_one_filed on {{schema}}.nep_gst_returns (company_id, period) where status = 'filed';
